parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 10000.

parameters.name: DeviceType
parameters.description: The operating system type for which the prohibited software has configured processes.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the prohibited software.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500.

parameters.name: PolicyId
parameters.description:
The ID of the software prohibition policy. You can obtain the value from the following operations:
- [ListProhibitedPolicies](~~ListProhibitedPolicies~~): Lists software prohibition policies.
- [CreateProhibitedPolicy](~~CreateProhibitedPolicy~~): Creates a software prohibition policy.

parameters.name: SoftwareIds
parameters.description: The collection of prohibited software IDs. Duplicate values are not allowed.

parameters.name: TagId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the prohibited software tag.
